# Canyon Outdoor

> Canyon Outdoor is a Southern California studio for landscape design, outdoor living concepts, hardscape concepts, and property visualization.

The studio creates planning studies and property visualizations. It is not a licensed contractor or construction company.

## Public pages

- `/`: Studio overview
- `/work`: Landscape, pool, water feature, grotto, waterslide, outdoor kitchen, and swim-up-bar concepts
- `/services`: Landscape design, outdoor living concepts, hardscape concepts, and property visualization
- `/process`: Design process
- `/privacy`: Privacy Policy
- `/terms`: Terms of Service

Use the Contact control on any public page to send a project inquiry.
